name: agent-bridge
description: Bounded parallel DSH development plus cross-harness consult, review and delegation with Claude Code, under one root controller per task

interface.shortDescription: Delegate bounded work to DSH and consult or cross-review with Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Coordinate isolated coding, review and integration tasks through DSH with explicit scope, durable results and controlled cleanup; ask Claude Code for independent review, a second opinion or a delegated sub-project without delegation loops.
interface.defaultPrompt: Plan this development task, define interfaces, delegate bounded implementation to DSH and cross-check risky decisions with Claude Code.
